--> Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources So This Happened (EP 442): Seyi Tinubu gives woman cash after declaring support for his father Video November 12, 2026 8:45 pm By Our Reporters Kindly share this story:
Seyi Tinubu, son of President Bola Tinubu, has sparked reactions online after a viral video showed him handing a bundle of cash to a female passenger in a commercial tricycle during a political mobilisation visit to Kebbi State. The woman had just expressed support for President Tinubu when Seyi handed her the money. Reps threaten action as ministers shun research fund hearing NUC approves new private university in Osun Join me in Rainbow Coalition or leave, Fubara tells supporters The incident has triggered debate about political generosity, voter influence and possible vote-buying ahead of the 2027 general elections. Although the video does not establish that the money was exchanged for a promise to vote, questions are being raised about whether political support should be earned through policies and performance rather than cash handouts.
